name: GitLabby
author: o_devvy
description: A GitLab issue board in a bar popup: your project's real boards in their label colors, who's busy, issue details with comments, labels and close, drag-to-move and bulk actions, merge requests for review, desktop alerts, and a hint for view-only projects.

barWidget.description: Shows a GitLab board's lists as columns. Click an issue for its details and comments, drag it or pick several to move, label or close them; see merge requests waiting on you, get alerts, and switch project and board from the popup.

schema.label: Default GitLab project
schema.description: Project opened on shell start, e.g. group/project. Empty: the first board you open in the picker. Star a board to change it.
